summary: Re-entry and unwritable-path fixes close their findings, but claimed-entry protection still has two collision and locking gaps.

findings.summary: Claim and add acquire different locks when improvements is a symlink.
findings.evidence: Plan item 3 requires a claimed own-run entry to be 'never overwritten'. add uses Path(home) / 'improvements' for its lock at lines 77 and 81, while claim resolves that directory at lines 273 and 279. If improvements is a symlink, lock.lock_path_for derives different lock files, so claim can race add's scan and replace and be overwritten back to ready. ENG-23 and ENG-26.
findings.fix: Derive the same canonical lock identity for both operations and add a regression test with a symlinked improvements directory.

findings.summary: New Retro names can collide with unchanged Run export names, allowing an export to overwrite a claimed Retro entry.
findings.evidence: FR-016 and plan item 3 require claimed entries never to be overwritten. For branch 'feature', the new Retro path is '<repo>-feature.<hash>.retro.halt-cluster.implement.json'. A legal branch named 'feature.<hash>.retro.halt-cluster.implement' has exactly that Run export path. export at lines 197-217 unconditionally replaces it, bypassing the new collision check at lines 165-168. ENG-26.
findings.fix: Make Retro and Run export destinations collision-safe in both write directions without silently replacing an existing entry; cover the conflicting legal branch and claimed-entry case.

findings.summary: Updated naming contract conflicts with completed task acceptance text.
findings.evidence: The changed plan requires '<repo-name>-<branch>.<repo-hash>.retro.<kind>.<subject>.json', but tasks.md T001 and T005 still require '<repo-name>-<branch>.retro.<kind>.<subject>.json'. The checked task's specified filename no longer matches the implementation or plan.
findings.fix: Update the task acceptance text to reflect the revised naming contract and legacy-entry handling.
